overview_description.description:
Tarabut’s platform allows organizations to access customer-permissioned financial data, initiate payments, and embed financial services such as lending and credit directly into digital products and marketplaces. This helps financial institutions deliver faster, more personalized financial experiences and expand access to financial services across the region.

The company operates mainly in Saudi Arabia, Bahrain, and the UAE, where it provides solutions including open finance APIs, payment initiation services, data intelligence tools, and embedded finance products. By connecting banks, fintech startups, and businesses in one ecosystem, Tarabut aims to accelerate digital banking innovation and improve financial inclusion in the MENA region.
